**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Section 13.1**

Section 13.1 sits at the playbook walk-away position: the licence runs to "Customer alone," is "non-transferable," is "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion," and expressly operates "without Affiliates or contractors."

It is also internally inconsistent with the rest of Section 13: 13.2 grants Customer *and its Affiliates* a perpetual, irrevocable paid-up licence with contractor support rights, and 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and bars revocation except for uncured breach after notice. Section 24.1 likewise allows assignment to Affiliates and successors.

Redline (validated, ok:true): the subscription grant now runs to Customer and its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf, is transferable per Sections 13.3 and 24, and may be revoked or suspended only as permitted by Section 13.3 — reaching the preferred position with a single-paragraph edit and no new definitions.
